author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After departing from the wine industry, Tony and Cherie Townsend embarked on a remarkable project to repurpose their 40-acre vineyard into a sanctuary for regent parrots. Their family and local volunteers, spanning four generations, are actively involved in this conservation initiative. Backed by the Murraylands and Riverland Landscape Board, over 3,000 native seedlings have been planted, fostering vital habitats and illustrating the crucial role private land plays in enhancing biodiversity.
title: Couple replace 40 acres of vines with native bush; rare parrots return

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ecologists Rebecca West and Reece Pedler are leading an inspiring initiative called the Wild Deserts project in New South Wales, focused on reviving native mammal populations that have been absent for over a century. Their efforts have successfully seen the reintroduction of multiple species to Sturt National Park, where they are now thriving and breeding in the wild.
title: Couple clear 4,000 hectares of pests; vanished Australian animals return

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Fares into Hyderabad reward early bookers more sharply than the rest of the domestic network. Across seven routes, a ticket bought 30 days before departure costs 28.5 per cent less than one bought the day before, compared with a 13.4 per cent saving across the network. The Kolkata to Hyderabad route shows the starkest gap, with day-before fares running 64.3 per cent above the 30-day price.
title: Hyderabad: Booking 30 days ahead is 28.5% cheaper than day before across 7 routes

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: Delhi’s air quality index reached 324 on Monday, marking a significant decline in air quality levels. As a result, the Commission for Air Quality Management has implemented GRAP-II to combat pollution. The city also faces restrictions on construction activities and vehicle entry based on their registration. Air quality is expected to remain in the 'very poor' category in the coming days.

Over 2,700 scholarships have been granted, reflecting their dedication to youth success. The foundation's initiatives encompass college readiness, career development, and community programs, urging recipients to contribute back through mentorship and service.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A groundbreaking study reveals the comeback of the Bangka slow loris, once feared lost or critically endangered. Over 90 individuals have been documented on Bangka Island from 2015 to 2025, shedding light on their survival. Wildlife rescues have been instrumental not only in recording their existence but also in aiding rehabilitation efforts.
title: Slow loris feared extinct since 1930s rediscovered; over 90 found in Indonesia

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After suffering extensive structural damage to her home from a failing wooden bulkhead, Elizabeth Molbert took legal action against the contractor involved and succeeded. The jury assigned 75% of the blame to the contractor and, in a twist, the appeals court ruled that Molbert had no fault in the matter, increasing her compensation to $448,431.34 and adjusting her mental anguish damages to align with her financial difficulties.
title: Woman wins nearly $450,000 after $32,500 flood barrier fails to save home

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists have announced that temperatures at 200 feet off Monterey Bay have reached their highest levels in nearly forty years. This rise is attributed to the forthcoming 2026-27 El Niño, with sightings of tropical species migrating northward, suggesting significant ecological transformations. These shifts in ocean conditions pose a risk to deep-sea food availability, impacting various marine ecosystems.
title: California records warmest deep waters in Monterey Bay in nearly 40 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A couple in Nebraska was on the brink of losing their family home due to a commercial lease debt solely tied to the husband. The creditor aimed to sell the property to reclaim funds. The Nebraska Supreme Court stepped in, clarifying that the lower court misapplied the judgment lien, which only affected the husband's interest.
title: Nebraska court blocks sale of wife's share of home over husband's lease debt

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft has priced a $25 billion bond sale, its first US investment-grade offering since 2017, just days after offering voluntary exit packages to about 60,000 employees. Orders hit $115 billion across ten tranches, while CFO Amy Hood flagged Azure demand outpacing supply. The money will fund AI data centre spending as capex nears $175 billion.
title: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees, borrows $25 billion to fuel AI push

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The LIPA held its 2026 graduation ceremony celebrating its 30th anniversary by awarding degrees to its very first graduates. With over 400 students from 28 different countries in attendance, this event marked a monumental occasion. Sir Paul McCartney was on hand to honor five notable figures for their artistry and impact on the cultural landscape, showcasing LIPA's commitment to nurturing creative talent across various fields, including music, theatre, and film.
title: Paul McCartney-backed Liverpool institute awards first degrees after 30 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant ruling, Nebraska's Supreme Court declared a handwritten will invalid, stating that the primary handwriting was not that of the testator. The court reaffirmed the original 1984 will, which allocated assets to the deceased's sons. This decision underlined the necessity for a holographic will to be solely in the writer's hand to clarify testamentary intent, especially amid disputes from a long-term partner after Douglas G. Todd's death.
title: Nebraska court rejects handwritten will written largely by man's partner

description: Becky Lynch and Seth Rollins have built a family life that exists alongside their demanding careers in WWE. Between raising daughter Roux and managing busy travel schedules, the couple's life reflects a balance of professional ambition and family priorities, from choosing homes to exploring business interests. They also keep much of their world away from public view because they are private people.

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Initiated in 2013, the Grenada Artificial Reef Project employs concrete blocks to foster marine life habitats. Remarkable progress was observed shortly after, with algae and various invertebrates flourishing on the structures. However, while research shows these artificial reefs attract species typical of natural environments, further studies are essential to evaluate their role in aiding natural reef recovery and assessing their long-term effects on adjacent ecosystems.
title: 100 cinder-block pyramids attract 30 fish species and 15 coral types in Grenada

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: The Hadwen-Wright House in Nantucket fetched an impressive $15.25 million, after being originally listed at $15.5 million. This stunning mansion, a prime example of Greek Revival architecture, is steeped in history. Its extensive renovations not only maintained original features but also unveiled a unique brick-lined cistern now preserved for guests. This sale highlights the lasting appeal of Nantucket's historically significant residences.
title: 845 Nantucket mansion bought for $4.7m sells for $15.25m after restoration

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A small Georgia city is facing a police staffing crisis after its entire full-time police force resigned. Mayor Craig Timmons admitted placing a GPS tracker on Police Chief Lamar Bunn's truck over concerns about his timesheets. Bunn has denied wrongdoing, while the mass resignations have left the city relying on the county sheriff's office for police coverage.
title: Georgia city's entire full-time police force quits after mayor tracks chief

author: SHARIQ MAJEED
description: A 15-year-old Class 10 student died by suicide at her home on Rahon Road on October 31. Her family has alleged that a 25-year-old woman pressured her for a same-sex marriage through Instagram. The girl's father reported that this pressure caused severe mental stress for his daughter. Police have registered a case against the accused, who has been arrested as part of the ongoing investigation.
title: Pressured for same-sex marriage, 15-year-old school girl dies by suicide

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: India's Dhinidhi Desinghu created history by winning bronze in the women's 100m freestyle at the 2026 Youth Olympics in Dakar, becoming the first Indian female swimmer to medal at the event. The 16-year-old clocked 56.27 seconds. Her coach Nihar Ameen backed her chances of another medal in the 200m freestyle. India also celebrated Khushbu Darjada's judo victory.
title: Historic! 16-yr-old Dhinidhi becomes first Indian swimmer to win a Youth Oly medal

author: SIVA G
description: A fire broke out on Monday evening at Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd's Visakh Refinery, causing significant concern in nearby industrial areas. Flames erupted near a tank containing Ruf Pitch Oil, alarming commuters passing by the location and leading to viral videos on social media. HPCL sources reported no injuries or casualties from the incident, but the cause remains unclear. Rumors of an explosion circulated, though officials considered that scenario unlikely.

He questions his daily efforts while seeking inspiration from his father's dedication to his career. Although he has performed well in domestic matches, the selector's perception limits his opportunities for overseas play. Sarfaraz's focus on fitness has resulted in significant weight loss and improved performance.

While Thomas's varying performance raises questions, it also provides a chance for reinvention.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Cuba's healthcare landscape is facing serious challenges, as critical medical supplies and equipment run dangerously low. Virtually paralyzed, doctors find it increasingly difficult to deliver effective patient care, with vulnerable groups like malnourished infants and life support-dependent patients at great risk during power outages. The Cuban government recognizes its involvement in this crisis, mainly attributing external issues to US sanctions.

description: Yip Ward and Paul Mappley went from living in a caravan in England to owning an abandoned French hamlet. The couple bought the property for £26,000, which includes seven cottages, two barns and other buildings. By carrying out much of the restoration themselves, they estimate they have saved more than £100,000 while bringing the historic hamlet back to life.
title: Unable to afford UK home, couple buy French hamlet for £26,000

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After three decades of craftsmanship, Denise and Greg Powell are parting ways with their extraordinary recycled-brick castle in Broad Bay. What began as a straightforward home evolved into a medieval masterpiece, complete with a secret trapdoor and various salvaged architectural details. As they downsize to a cozier residence nearby, this unique property has seen its value soar since their acquisition in the early 90s.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: In a stunning display of skill, Harsh Dubey grabbed nine wickets in a Ranji Trophy clash against Madhya Pradesh, setting a new record for Vidarbha. description: For the first time, Alexander Zverev has ascended to the world No. 1 ranking, marking a significant achievement in his career. This impressive feat comes on the heels of his triumphs at the French Open and US Open. His rise to the top occurred after Jannik Sinner, the previous holder of the title, decided to conclude his season.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: After years of meticulous planning, volunteers from City Island Oyster Reef successfully installed six reef balls in Eastchester Bay. These structures were intentionally seeded with oyster larvae to bolster local oyster populations. This initiative stems from thorough monitoring of both water quality and the ecosystem around City Island. Remarkably, marine species like fish and crabs have started to thrive in the area.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The Fish and Game Department of New Hampshire has initiated a five-year period of closure at Great Bay to facilitate oyster restoration efforts. This move affects two key sites, one near Woodman Point and another near Nannie Island. Significant measures are being implemented to combat the alarming 90% decline in oyster reefs since 1970, involving collaboration between researchers and conservation groups to rejuvenate oyster populations and restore essential marine habitats.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Samrat and Varshali Dambe lost their jobs in 2024, prompting them to pursue a long-held dream. They embarked on an 80-day motorcycle journey around India, covering 16,428 kilometers. During their ride, they encountered welcoming people and faced challenging terrains throughout their travels. Their journey received recognition from the India Book of Records for their achievements. After completing their expedition, they founded a community to connect fellow motorcycle enthusiasts.
title: Jobless Maharashtra couple rides 16,428km across 22 states, sets record

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The government is addressing a dispute regarding reduced import duties on bulk Scotch whisky imports. Liquor industry executives were assured that these imports qualify for the 75 percent duty reduction. The disagreement arose after tax officials questioned the eligibility of bulk shipments under the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement. Major liquor companies, including Diageo and Pernod Ricard, have been affected by this dispute.
title: India moves to resolve Scotch tariff dispute, assures 75% duty on bulk imports

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Louisiana man died without a will in 1956, and a court recognised his daughter as the heir to his estate in 1996. Nearly 30 years later, another family challenged her right to inherit a 50% share of a property. On October 30, the Louisiana Supreme Court rejected the challenge as legally time-barred, upholding the earlier inheritance ruling.
title: Louisiana family's bid to overturn 30-year-old inheritance ruling fails

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Former rower and canoeist Manjeet Singh has been elected unopposed to the IOA Athletes’ Commission after being the sole male medallist category nominee. Kidambi Srikanth withdrew, leaving 10 candidates, including PV Sindhu, Mirabai Chanu and Harmanpreet Singh, competing for nine remaining seats in Tuesday’s (November 3) elections.
title: IOA Elections: Manjeet Singh elected into Athletes' Commission; Srikanth withdraws

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Cyclone Murasu has intensified and is predicted to cross the south Andhra Pradesh coast soon. It is expected to bring strong winds reaching up to 120 kmph and heavy rainfall. Several districts in Andhra Pradesh will experience severe weather conditions due to the cyclone. Precautionary measures have been implemented, including rescue operations and evacuation arrangements. Fishermen have been advised to avoid venturing into the sea during this period.
title: Cyclone Murasu to make landfall near at Andhra coast tonight; 120 kmph winds expected

author: NEEL KAMAL
description: Bhim Singh, father of the slain anti-drug activist Parwinder Singh Jhota, requested certain political figures to stay away from a protest. Singh expressed his concerns regarding the presence of Rahul Gandhi and the family of Beant Singh. He emphasized the ongoing tensions within the Sikh community towards the legacy of Indira Gandhi. Additionally, Singh criticized local MLA Vijay Singla for his comments on the protest's impact on business.
title: Murdered Punjab anti-drug activist's kin seeks 'distance' from Indira Gandhi family

author: SWATI DESHPANDE
description: Imran Khan, a US citizen and OCI card holder, faced a Leave India Notice from the Centre. The Bombay high court granted him interim relief after he submitted an unconditional apology. The court clarified that OCI holders don't have the same rights as Indian citizens, particularly regarding protests. Additional Solicitor General Anil Singh argued that the Centre has the power to expel foreigners.
title: 'Cannot behave like an Indian': HC raps Imran Khan; asks govt to be 'magnanimous'

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: IndiGo has made significant strides by onboarding 600 pilots in just the first half of this fiscal year. With plans to hire an additional 400 by March 2024, the airline is focused on compliance with pilot duty regulations and strategic international expansion. Given the current geopolitical climate, which is influencing operating costs like aviation turbine fuel, IndiGo is evaluating potential fuel hedging strategies to support its long-haul service growth.

title: FPCE writes to PM Modi, lists 5 key changes to RERA to strengthen homebuyer protection

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Stockpiles of air defense missiles are being depleted faster than they can be replenished during international conflicts. Ukraine's reliance on advanced interceptors has surged as Russia increases missile attacks on its infrastructure. Although the United States has approved a possible sale of 500 PAC-3 MSE interceptors to Ukraine, production limits hinder timely delivery. Manufacturing constraints and competing demands from allied nations complicate the situation further.
title: Ukraine has 500 Patriot missiles on order, but Russia's winter offensive exposes a critical gap

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Fridges hacked, food spoiled: Cyberattack disrupts supermarkets across Europe

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Esmail Baghaei, spokesperson for the Iranian foreign ministry, has branded the United States as the foremost danger to global nuclear non-proliferation. He raised alarms over military threats from the U.S., which he claims undermine the Non-Proliferation Treaty. Amid ongoing pressures, Iran's discussions about its nuclear policy have intensified, yet the country remains steadfast in honoring its nuclear commitments, maintaining a peaceful program that has been validated repeatedly.
title: Iran calls US biggest threat to NPT, warns of stronger defence push

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Rahul has no vision, will be responsible for Cong's wipeout': BJP on anti-SIR march

author: POULOMI GHOSH
description: As no names of the victims of the Learjet plane crash have been revealed, social media speculations were intense. Alexandra Dudgeon was named as the female pilot of the doomed plane for a few hours after the crash with no official confirmation. Dudgeon apparently issued a statement asserting that she was not on the plane. Then social media speculations picked one Nathalia Filgueiras as the female pilot. There has been no official confirmation, only social media speculations.
title: Female pilot's identity unconfirmed after Learjet crash amid online rumours

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A recent study from Cornell University demonstrates that allowing sheep to graze beneath solar panels can enhance insect diversity. It found that maintaining two sheep per hectare led to a remarkable 38% rise in beneficial insects, particularly honey bees. As sheep density increased, researchers discovered a critical balance between effective vegetation management and preserving bee health.
title: Sheep grazing under solar panels boosts honey bees by 83%: Cornell study

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a surprising discovery, a family in London uncovered a mounted thylacine head tucked away in a box under their bed. This extraordinary specimen, one of only three known in existence, boasts a remarkable value. Auctioneum estimates it will fetch between £30,000 and £50,000 at their upcoming auction. Authenticated and cataloged in a global database, it's an attractive opportunity for collectors and museums, given the stringent regulations on such items.
title: Rare Tasmanian tiger head found under London bed could fetch £50,000

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: In the recent T20I series against New Zealand, Naman Dhir showcased his prowess, garnering the Impact Player of the Series accolade. Scoring 138 runs over five matches, he significantly contributed to India's early victories. His performance in the middle order underscored his importance, even with just two overs bowled. Now, with the T20I series behind them, India looks forward to the impending ODI matches.
title: Naman Dhir makes his mark on maiden overseas tour, wins India's Impact Player medal

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
title: Blue wave meets red flag: On cusp of big win, Dems face internal sabotage

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Alex Karp acquired 15,000 hectares of forest land in Härjedalen, Sweden, through his company Cladonia Skog AB. The purchase was confirmed by Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget, which previously owned the forest land. Hunters in the area received notification about the termination of their leasing agreements after the sale. A representative from Cladonia expressed commitment to preserving the natural landscape and its habitats.
title: Alex Karp buys 37,000 acres of Swedish forest for $22M; why hunters are barred

author: PALLAVI
description: Akhilesh Yadav's recent visit to Azam Khan in jail underscores their deep political connection amidst ongoing legal troubles. Following Azam's fleeting bail, the Enforcement Directorate swiftly took him back into custody, adding complexity to the Samajwadi Party's election preparations. Balancing support for Azam while appealing to Muslim constituents presents a significant challenge for Akhilesh as he navigates potential electoral repercussions.
title: 'Azam the, Azam hain': Will the Khan factor help or haunt Akhilesh in 2027 polls?

author: VRITI JAIN
description: Delhi’s air quality slipped to ‘very poor’ for the first time this season, with AQI at 324, the highest in nine months. CAQM invoked GRAP Stage 2, while vehicle checks at borders caused long jams. The High Court refused to stay curbs on non-BS-VI vehicles, and the Supreme Court allowed certified green crackers for two days before Diwali.
title: GRAP-2 curbs imposed in Delhi as AQI hits ‘very poor’ category at 324

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Kimi Antonelli’s rise to Formula 1 glory carries a deeply personal story. His father, Marco Antonelli, once feared his son would face the same financial struggles and career disappointments he experienced in motorsport. However, Kimi’s exceptional karting talent attracted Mercedes’ attention and changed his future. At just 20, he has become Formula 1’s youngest world champion, turning his father’s early fears into immense pride and a remarkable family achievement.
title: Kimi Antonelli's father once feared for his racing future before F1 title win

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ahmedabad's Crime Branch has taken action against 61 suspected illegal immigrants, mostly hailing from Bangladesh, in a city-wide effort to bolster safety ahead of Diwali. The police executed synchronized raids across different localities to pinpoint foreign nationals living without legal status. Deportation processes are currently being initiated, furthering previous measures aimed at curbing illegal immigration from Bangladesh.
title: 61 detained in Ahmedabad as crackdown on illegal Bangladeshi immigrants intensifies

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: In an extraordinary display of teamwork, on November 1, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers triumphed over the Atlanta Falcons without needing any completed passes. Baker Mayfield barely threw, managing only three attempts, while the running game took charge with 324 rushing yards. Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell shone bright, each setting career-best rushing records. The phenomenal Buccaneers defense stifled the Falcons, forcing four interceptions from Michael Penix Jr.
title: Baker Mayfield's Buccaneers repeat rare 1974 NFL feat in 16-0 win over Falcons

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce, the 37 year old Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, has found himself in a mess due to his charity.
title: Travis Kelce's charity 87 & Running faces questions over $1.1 million spending

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Terror-related violence in Jammu & Kashmir has declined to its lowest levels in decades, indicating improved stability. Data shows that just two security personnel fatalities occurred during the current year, reflecting a significant reduction. Recruitment of locals into terrorist groups has also sharply decreased, with no new recruits reported in 2026. Furthermore, the law-and-order situation has improved, with no incidents of civil unrest this year.
title: No successful infiltration across LoC in 2026 as J&K sees sharp decline in terror violence

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: As hundreds of polar bears gather near Churchill in Canada, conservationists are testing noisy drones to move them away from populated areas. They are also developing AI-powered cameras to detect approaching bears and installing electric fencing at a waste facility. The measures aim to protect people and animals as climate change delays sea ice formation, increasing the risk of encounters.
title: Canada tests noisy drones as hundreds of polar bears prepare to gather

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists discovered a rare white mineral called Jadarite in Serbia in 2004, later finding that its chemical composition closely matched Superman's fictional Kryptonite. Unlike the glowing green substance, Jadarite is neither green nor radioactive. New research suggests the mineral could supply a significant portion of Europe's lithium needs for electric vehicles, although local opposition has prevented mining operations.
title: Scientists find Serbian mineral almost identical to Superman's kryptonite

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Nihal Sarin broke into the world's Top 20 for the first time, reaching a career-best World No. 19 with 2720 rating points after winning individual gold at the European Chess Club Cup. India also has 13 players in the Open Top 100 and 11 in the Women's Top 100, while remaining the world's second-ranked chess federation across all three categories.
title: FIDE Rankings: Pragg only Indian chess player in world's top 10; where is Gukesh?

author: VRITI JAIN
description: Sharad Pawar, the chief of NCP (SP), was admitted to Ruby Hall Clinic in Pune this week. His daughter, Supriya Sule, stated he experienced pleuritic pain following a cough. Medical tests indicated that all his health parameters remained stable during his hospital stay. Doctors expect his condition to improve while he continues to be observed for precautionary reasons.
title: NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar admitted with chest pain in Pune

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jamie Dimon, the CEO of JP Morgan, emphasizes the dangers of bureaucracy in organizations during a recent conference. He suggests companies remove managers who prioritize processes over outcomes to enhance efficiency. Dimon also identifies signs of bureaucracy, such as information withholding and unnecessary delays in communication. To address this, he recommends distributing meeting materials in advance for better transparency.
title: Jamie Dimon to European companies: Fire managers who value process over results

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: BCCI has announced a strong 15-member India A squad for the upcoming ACC Men's Rising Stars Asia Cup. The tournament will take place in Doha, Qatar, from November 19 to 29, featuring several promising players. Tilak Varma will captain the squad, with Rajat Patidar as his deputy for the competition. India A is placed in Group B alongside Pakistan A, Nepal, and UAE for the group stage.
title: Abhishek, Sooryavanshi feature in Tilak-led India A squad for Rising Stars Asia Cup

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: In a significant legal development, the Delhi high court has intervened to temporarily suspend the termination of Jawaharlal Nehru University professor Angomcha Bimol Akoijam. Facing sexual harassment allegations from 11 female students filed in May, Akoijam has refuted the claims and is appealing his dismissal from October 9. An internal committee had suggested disciplinary measures after its investigation.
title: Delhi HC stays JNU professor Bimol Akoijam's termination over sexual harassment

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: In a verbal blitzkrieg, a day after Rahul's mega Ramlila Maidan rally in the national capital, Shah said that behind the Congress's criticism of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) lies an "attempt to protect illegal Bangladeshi infiltrators", three crore of whom, he claimed, were struck off the electoral rolls during the revision.
title: '3 crore Bangladeshi infiltrators': Amit Shah counters Rahul's anti-SIR pitch

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: 'You became PM because of foreign help': Rahul challenges PM Modi for open debate

author: HADI KHAN
description: Increasingly, couples in India turn to prescription weight-loss medicines to enhance their appearance before weddings. Clinics in cities like Lucknow report a significant rise in inquiries about these medications. Many individuals seek rapid results to boost confidence for their special day, despite potential health risks. Medical professionals highlight the importance of eligibility criteria and caution against misuse of these drugs.
title: Injecting to crush kilos: The rise of ‘Mounjaro’ brides

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Virginia couple's dream garden sparks dispute over backyard land

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A letter written by Titanic passenger George Graham on April 10, 1912, shortly before the ship left Southampton, revealed his hope of meeting a business colleague in Berlin the following year. Graham died when the Titanic sank five days later. The letter survived and was eventually sold for $16,100 at an auction in New York, setting a world record.
title: Titanic passenger's 1912 letter calls ship a 'magnificent floating town'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Chakaia Booker recently unveiled her stunning 17-foot sculpture named 'Transit' at Lock 3 park in Akron, Ohio. Crafted from recycled Goodyear Eagle F1 racing tyres, the piece pays homage to the city's rubber industry legacy. Composed of two elegantly curved forms supported by stainless steel, this installation, initiated in 2023, emphasizes the importance of contemporary public art created by female artists.
title: Discarded racing tyres become 17-foot sculpture in Ohio park

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Texas farmer earns $200,000 a year leasing 600 acres for solar panels

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The hosts were found to be one over short after time allowances were taken into consideration by Match Referee Jeff Crowe.
title: Pak punished after tri-series win; Babar advised to 'go to Australia' amid poor form

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A California accountant has been sentenced to 63 months in prison for defrauding investors of more than $8.2 million through fake real estate projects. Ethan Joseph Sanchez promised to use their money to build backyard homes but instead lost it through risky day trading. A federal judge also ordered him to forfeit over $8.2 million and pay restitution to victims.
title: California accountant jailed as $8.2m for backyard homes lost in trading

author: ASHISH MISHRA
description: Eight people, including seven trekkers and their guide, remain missing in Uttarkashi’s Kedartal region three days after an avalanche blocked their return route. Two helicopter sorties on Sunday failed to spot the group or their tents, as heavy snowfall and fresh avalanche threats hamper operations. Another SDRF mountaineering team has been deployed with specialised equipment. The trekking agency claims rescue began late, while its own team turned back a kilometre short of the tent.
title: Kedartal avalanche: 8 trekkers still missing after 2 failed helicopter sorties

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India secured a 3-2 T20I series win against New Zealand, showcasing a powerful beginning despite faltering in the final matches. Captain Shreyas Iyer expressed his pride in the team's efforts using the Maori expression 'Ka mau te wehi.' While recognizing the need for batting and bowling enhancements after losing the last match, Coach Gautam Gambhir celebrated Iyer's effective guidance of a young bowling squad under tough conditions.
title: Shreyas' four-word post after India win NZ series leaves fans searching for meaning

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: Actor Imran Khan apologises in Bombay HC for participating in anti-SIR protest

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ved Rahi, a renowned Dogri writer and filmmaker, has left us at the age of 93. His celebrated work, 'Aale,' which debuted in 1983, earned critical acclaim. The Sahitya Akademi mourned his death, recognizing his profound influence on Indian literature. Rahi's legacy not only enriched Dogri literature but also made significant strides in Hindi cinema and cultural identity, marking a notable loss for the literary world and society at large.
title: Sahitya Akademi pays tribute to veteran Dogri writer and filmmaker Ved Rahi

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The US midterm elections are set for November 3, affecting Congress and local offices. Voters will select members of the House and Senate, impacting legislative control. Republican majorities currently hold both chambers, with Democrats needing net gains to gain control. Key issues influencing voter decisions include inflation, immigration, and administration performance. Election results will be determined by state officials and may lead to contested outcomes in closely fought races.
title: US midterm elections 2026: What they are, why they matter and when results will be out

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The recommendations have been submitted ahead of the annual Union Budget scheduled for February. However, they are advisory in nature, and the final decision on whether to accept them rests with the government. The proposal comes as authorities look for ways to revive India's equity markets, which have been performing below the level of their emerging market counterparts.
title: LTCG tax relief on cards? Sebi wants tax scrapped for foreign investors

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ukraine has resumed drone attacks on Russian oil refineries after a US proposal for a temporary halt. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy insists that these strikes are in response to ongoing Russian attacks. Meanwhile, Russia accuses Ukraine of ignoring US efforts to negotiate peace while continuing strikes. These attacks aim to disrupt Russian fuel supplies and damage its revenue sources.
title: Ukraine defies Trump, puts Russian oil refineries back in the firing line

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The fraud came to light later, when the depositors discovered that the documents they had received were forged and that no accounts had actually been opened in their names. Despite the losses suffered by the customers, the Department of Posts declined to return their money. The affected depositors, however, maintained that the fraud had been carried out through the actions of postal department employees.
title: Rs 36.4 lakh fraud: Transferred Post Office staff issue fake NSCs; what Court ruled

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Shweta Tripathi initially envisioned herself as a mother, but her experiences transformed her outlook. She faced a toxic relationship that prompted her to reconsider gender roles in parenting. The shock of discovering her low AMH levels further complicated her thoughts on motherhood. Conversations with various mothers enriched her understanding of the challenges of parenthood. Ultimately, Shweta and her husband chose to be child-free, focusing instead on their personal journey.
title: Shweta Tripathi opens up about low fertility and changing views on motherhood

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Indiana father who lost his $350,000-a-year job after 26 years and moved to Virginia for work has lost his appeal in a custody dispute. The Indiana Court of Appeals upheld a decision granting his ex-wife sole legal custody and primary physical custody of their son. It also ordered him to pay $4,000 towards her legal fees, citing the income difference between the parents.
title: Indiana dad loses custody appeal after $350,000 job loss and move to Virginia

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission in Goa ruled against a renovation contractor for failing to complete the work. The contractor received Rs 18 lakh but allegedly did not follow agreed specifications. Evidence showed significant shortcomings in the renovation and restoration of the property. The commission ordered a refund of Rs 11 lakh along with interest and compensation. The contractor must comply within 45 days of receiving the order to avoid further penalties.
title: Goa heritage home renovation abandoned midway: Contractor told to pay Rs 13.8 lakh

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Confronted with a severe water shortage in Hyderabad, Ranga Prasad embarked on rainwater harvesting as a solution. After facing difficulties in securing professional assistance, he learned to build recharge pits independently, leading to the installation of over 600 systems across the city. Prasad stresses the vital need for upkeep of these installations to ensure their longevity and champions community-driven water conservation, illustrating how personal endeavors can drive significant environmental progress.
title: Hyderabad man builds over 600 rainwater pits after learning the skill himself

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Ama Sangrahalaya, curated by retired Urdu teacher Abdul Wadood Khan, houses an impressive collection of over 1,000 historical artifacts. This museum includes fascinating items such as gramophones and vintage newspapers that highlight the rich tapestry of daily life throughout various periods. Committed to education, Khan actively engages with visitors, ensuring generations understand and cherish their cultural heritage through these remarkable relics.
title: Odisha teacher turns home into museum after collecting 1,000 old objects

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Prafulla Kumar Sahoo has devoted 45 years to mastering the art of handloom weaving in Odisha. With each saree taking nearly a month to complete, he features a unique Patta design. Beyond his craftsman skills, he has empowered over 200 unemployed individuals by providing them weaving training for sustainable livelihoods.
title: Odisha weaver preserves 45-year craft, trains over 200 people

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Kentucky landowner faced a setback as the state's Court of Appeals upheld a dismissal of his compensation claim related to floodplain regulations. Since he did not apply for necessary variances or receive final decisions on development, the court's affirmation of the lower court's ruling complicates his plans. However, the ruling leaves room for potential future claims if proper administrative steps are taken.
title: Owner paid $800,000 for Ohio River land, loses floodplain compensation appeal

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Pujara feels Kohli's position at number three gives him more time to settle in and build an innings. Rohit, meanwhile, usually has the responsibility of giving India an aggressive start during the powerplay
title: Kohli has better chance of scoring century than Rohit: Pujara drops big verdict

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Afghanistan's cricket team has achieved a historic milestone by entering the top six of the ICC Men's ODI Team Rankings. They have surpassed Sri Lanka after consistent performances and landmark victories against major teams. Their climb follows notable wins during the 2023 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup and T20 World Cup. Afghanistan recently completed a dominant series against Ireland, Zimbabwe, and Bangladesh in various formats.
title: Highest-ever! Afghanistan make historic leap, overtake SL, ENG & WI in ODI rankings

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At 60, Glenwood Hoskin Jr. from Pennsylvania shattered the previous cinema attendance record by watching 1,207 films in a year, averaging 3.3 movies daily. His secret? Meticulous planning around movie schedules and a keen eye on expenses with a membership program. A strong fan of animated films and comedies, he credited the audience’s laughter for enhancing the comedy experience.
title: US man watches 1,207 movies in a year, sets Guinness World Record

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Halloween turns deadly across US as gun violence leaves at least 24 dead, 94 injured

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Larry Ellison emphasizes that AI advancements could lead to increased productivity and economic growth. He suggests that taxing the value generated by robots could replace traditional labor taxation methods. This approach could support a universal high income, improving living standards for individuals. Ellison believes that while some jobs may be displaced, automation will create opportunities for more efficient work.
title: US on right AI track; robots take jobs, right tax system needed: Larry Ellison

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Tejashwi Yadav, Bihar leader of the opposition, said Sonia Gandhi had personally expressed a desire to meet his father after learning that he was in Delhi for a medical check-up. He also pointed out that the then Prime Minister Manmohan Singh's government had allocated more than Rs 1.45 lakh crore for Bihar's development.
title: Sonia meets Lalu in Delhi; Tejashwi shares photos, reminisces UPA-era tie

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: In a surprising turn of events, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation decided to pull Dia Mirza's video from its pollution-free Diwali campaign, bowing to political pressure from the Mumbai BJP chief Ameet Satam, who voiced concerns over her participation. Mayor Ritu Tawde’s remarks labeling Mirza as anti-Hindu sparked further outrage, while other celebrities like Madhuri Dixit continued in the campaign.
title: 'Dia Mirza is against Hindutva': Mumbai mayor on actors' appeal against firecrackers

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: SC permits green crackers in Delhi-NCR on Diwali; blanket ban kicks in from Nov 9

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Contracts worth Rs 53,866.50 crore for eight Next Generation Corvettes have been signed by the Indian Ministry of Defence. The ships will be built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers and Goa Shipyard Limited. Designed in-house by the Indian Navy, these vessels will enhance maritime capabilities and replace ageing corvettes. The project aims to create significant job opportunities in the shipbuilding sector and ancillary industries.
title: Indian Navy to get 8 home-designed warships in Rs 53,866 crore deal: What sets them apart

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Shakira's foundation helps 224,000 children, builds schools and boosts higher education

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: China is tightening export controls on construction equipment which could significantly affect India's ongoing infrastructure projects. The new restrictions will limit access to tunnel-boring machines and essential components. India plans to reduce its reliance on Chinese machinery by boosting domestic production and investment. Various Indian companies are exploring manufacturing their own construction equipment to meet burgeoning demand. Analysts suggest these changes may impact infrastructure development along the disputed Himalayan border.
title: China to restrict exports of giant tunnel-digging machines; why India could be affected

author: AMBIKA PANDIT
description: In a momentous gathering, the INDIA bloc's supporters came together at Ramlila Maidan to address pressing political issues. Leaders from multiple parties spoke passionately about the necessity for change, particularly calling for the ousting of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. This event highlighted the importance of unity against perceived electoral injustices, with speakers weaving in historical contexts to bolster their arguments regarding voting rights and electoral fairness.
title: Posters, placards & punchlines deliver message at INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan

author: TOI Education
description: India's traditional engineering-to-IT career pathway is facing growing uncertainty as artificial intelligence reshapes entry-level jobs. Citing figures highlighted by Chetan Bhagat in his The Times of India column, the article examines the widening gap between rising engineering enrolments and declining technology-sector hiring. It explores how AI is changing fresher recruitment, the potential experience gap for future professionals, and why students and parents may need to rethink career choices, embrace AI skills and reconsider blue-collar professions.
title: Engineering enrolments rise 47%, tech jobs fall 70%: Is India's career dream fading?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Launched in 1992, Auroville's EcoService initiative started with two people collecting waste on a cycle rickshaw. Fast forward to today, an 11-member team organizes the collection and sorting of hundreds of kilograms of waste every day. The initiative encourages residents to categorize their waste for improved recycling, and it has engaged local women, referred to as Ammas, in a secondary segregation process.
title: Auroville waste drive began with cycle rickshaw, now diverts 80% from landfills

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The fortunes of Sergey Brin and Larry Page took a hit as Alphabet's stock fell over 12%. This decline was fueled by slower growth in Google's fundamental search sector and increasing expenditures on AI projects. Although cloud services demonstrated impressive growth, the company's quarterly revenue came in below expectations, heightened by new European regulations and significant AI spending, spurring concerns about future profitability.
title: Sergey Brin’s net worth drops $29 billion as Alphabet stock tumbles

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Mira Kapoor opened up about the collaborative parenting style she shares with her husband, Shahid. They strategically divide their responsibilities according to their strengths, paving the way for a harmonious family life. Mira brings attention to how vital gender equality is in instilling values such as respect and kindness in their children. Their adaptable routines help manage everyday unpredictability, fostering a nurturing and supportive atmosphere for their family.
title: Mira Kapoor reveals how she and Shahid divide parenting duties at home

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Co-founder of Veggie Nuggets, Emily Herra, collaborated with a team to revitalize an abandoned plot into a vibrant community garden. Despite facing setbacks, such as a contractor's destruction of their work, the group demonstrated resilience and rebuilt their garden. Their dedication earned them the Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes, which aids future climate activism. Herra's initiative spotlights the impactful role youth can play in fostering sustainability in their communities.
title: Meet Emily Herra, 17, who turned vacant lot into garden and won $10,000

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India's manufacturing sector showed slower growth in October as output and new orders moderated. Despite this slowdown, there was an increase in new export orders, reflecting stronger overseas demand. Factory employment rose for the second consecutive month, although job creation eased slightly from September. Input cost inflation also fell to its lowest levels since February. However, business confidence weakened as manufacturers anticipated a less optimistic outlook for the year ahead.
title: India's manufacturing PMI eases to 54.7 in October as export orders hit six-month high

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: India had also beaten Australia in the semi-final to book their place in the title clash. After years of coming close, the team finally had a chance to win the trophy.
title: Shafali's heroics, Deepti's five-for: The Navi Mumbai night that changed cricket

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A woman who moved from China to Kentucky on a fiance visa and signed a prenuptial agreement just 11 days after arriving in the US has lost her legal challenge following her divorce. Despite her husband's assets exceeding $1 million compared with her $39,000, the Kentucky Court of Appeals upheld the agreement, rejecting her claims of pressure and language difficulties.
title: Kentucky court upholds prenup signed 11 days after woman arrived on fiance visa

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: 'Don't travel by air. Next case': SC judge on plea alleging 700% airfare hike

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Tech entrepreneur Gökçe Güven, sentenced to 25 months in prison, orchestrated a significant fraud by misleading investors about her startup's performance. Through the use of fake documents and dual accounting systems, she raised funds based on false pretenses. In addition, she unlawfully obtained a visa by distorting facts in her application and is now required to pay approximately $6.7 million in restitution to her victims.
title: Women tech CEO, winner of 'Forbes 30 under 30', sentenced to 25 months in prison

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: The Indian Defence Ministry signed contracts with two shipyards for constructing eight next generation corvettes. Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited will build five corvettes while Goa Shipyard Limited will build three. These ships will enhance the Indian Navy's operational capabilities and support indigenous shipbuilding efforts. The project will create significant employment opportunities in shipbuilding and ancillary industries over the next decade.
title: Defence min inks Rs 53,866cr deal with GRSE & GSL for 8 next-gen corvettes for Navy

title: ‘Rahul camp insecure of Priyanka’: BJP alleges rift, claims sister being 'sidelined'

author: TNN
description: Police have suspended an assistant sub-inspector and initiated a special investigation team inquiry after disturbing footage emerged. This footage allegedly shows the officer planting drugs in the home of Mahant Kashmir Giri. Following the incident, the accused individual has been discharged from custody and departmental inquiries are ongoing. Accountability in the Punjab Police is a priority during the anti-drug campaign in the region.
title: Punjab cop caught on camera planting drugs at Shiv Sena leader's house

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Stock market recommendations: BSE, and Symbiotec Pharmalab - these are the top stocks to buy this week (starting November 2, 2026), as recommended by Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk.
title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for this week - check list

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: Ukraine and Russia's emergency alert systems faced cyberattacks that resulted in false warnings about nuclear threats. Ukraine's air raid alert app transmitted fake messages conveying chemical and radiation dangers to residents. Meanwhile, Russian authorities reported similar disruptions aimed at their mobile applications that spread misleading information. The incidents coincide with ongoing military operations and humanitarian efforts in the region.

description: Irfan Pathan has raised concerns regarding the selection of Bhuvneshwar Kumar in the recent T20I series. Despite his experience, Bhuvneshwar struggled to perform effectively during the matches against New Zealand. Pathan indicated that this decision prevented young bowlers from gaining valuable experience in international cricket. He emphasized the need for selectors to provide opportunities for emerging fast bowlers. This approach is crucial for their development, especially in challenging playing conditions.
title: 180 runs, 1 wicket! 'Playing Bhuvneshwar was a mistake': Ex-star to selectors

title: 'Nuclear war rehearsal': North Korea to strengthen deterrent after US-South Korea drills

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: A private Learjet 60 crashed into a residential area in Greenacres, Florida, resulting in the deaths of all nine passengers. The aircraft, which was en route to the Bahamas, experienced critical failures after reporting icing and turbulence. Eyewitness accounts described a dramatic descent followed by a massive explosion upon impact. Emergency services evacuated nearby residents, although no injuries were reported on the ground.
title: 'Looked like a missile': Jet crash leaves massive crater in Florida - video

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Tucker Carlson has claimed that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressuring US President Donald Trump for military action. This action is reportedly a nuclear strike aimed at Pickaxe Mountain in Iran, where nuclear activities are believed to be ongoing. Carlson suggests that the pressure could lead to a decision within days, escalating regional tensions. Diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran continue, though military options remain under consideration.
title: Netanyahu pushing Trump for nuclear strike on Iran? US commentator makes big claim

author: PAYAL DHAWAN
description: In a tragic turn of events, Ravinder Singh has been accused of murdering his wife Kamaldeep Kaur shortly after his return from Australia. The crime unfolded when their son, Gagandeep Singh, went to fetch milk, only to return and discover his mother lying in a pool of blood. Authorities have arrested Ravinder, suspecting infidelity as a potential motive, while investigations into the horrific crime are ongoing.
title: Ludhiana man stabs wife to death days after returning from Australia

description: The US is exploring a plan to resume Russian natural gas supplies to Europe through Ukraine as part of efforts to secure an energy ceasefire and advance peace talks. The proposal could offer Moscow a financial incentive while providing Kyiv with transit revenue, but faces strong European opposition amid concerns over renewed dependence on Russia.
title: US explores route to bring Russian gas back to Europe through Ukraine: Report

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh indicated significant growth opportunities for the airline despite rising fuel costs. The airline reported a net loss of Rs 1,879.1 crore due to elevated expenses and rupee depreciation. Walsh anticipates deliveries of wide-body Airbus A350 aircraft beginning in the second quarter of 2028. IndiGo plans to shift some international flights to the new Navi Mumbai airport to capitalize on upcoming opportunities.
title: 'We will navigate through challenges': IndiGo CEO on airline industry's tough phase

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Shubman Gill put in a nearly three-hour workoutat Eden Park, combining an extended batting session with intensive fielding drills, while KLRahul was the only other designated batter tohit the nets. Virat Kohli opted for a gym session,with Rohit Sharma and Ruturaj Gaikwad also staying indoors ahead of India's ODI series opener against New Zealand on November 4.
title: Gill turns up the volume at Eden Park; Kohli opts for gym, Rohit stays indoors

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In a recent ruling, a consumer commission addressed the distressing case of a man wrongly pursued by CapFloat Financial Services and Karur Vysya Bank for a loan he never authorized. Despite his lack of application, he faced persistent demands for repayment. After legal action and police involvement, the commission mandated the financial institutions to amend his credit history and awarded him compensation for mental distress and legal fees.
title: Chased for Rs 30K loan he never took; commission orders CIBIL fix, Rs 35K relief

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Cristiano Ronaldo will miss Al-Nassr's AFC Champions League match against Pakhtakor in Uzbekistan as the Saudi Arabian club looks to manage its players' workload amid a busy schedule and travel demands. The Portuguese superstar has been left out of the squad by coach Ange Postecoglou for Monday's match in Tashkent. Kingsley Coman and Mohamed Simakan have also been rested.
title: Ronaldo rested for Al-Nassr's Uzbekistan trip amid growing security concerns

author: BIJU MATHEW
description: Delhi is set to implement restrictions on older vehicles that fail to meet BS6 emission standards from entering the city. However, officials are grappling with the difficulty of monitoring numerous entry points, especially during rush hours. Leveraging technology, such as automatic number plate recognition, will be essential for identifying non-compliant vehicles. Collaboration between Delhi and neighboring NCR states is vital to prevent alternative routes and ensure effective enforcement.
title: Delhi's vehicle ban faces big test at borders: Can enforcement keep up?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Riyana Suree, a pioneering transgender woman from Tamil Nadu, is on a mission to empower her community. By founding the Thiru Aval Trust, she creates pathways for transgender individuals seeking education and employment. Overcoming her own obstacles, Riyana has helped numerous individuals receive sponsorships and support. With plans to broaden initiatives in creative sectors, she champions equal opportunities for all.
title: Rejected despite degree, Tamil Nadu trans woman now helps others find homes

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Gold price prediction today: On the upside, Rs 140,500–141,000 is now the first important hurdle, followed by Rs 143,000–144,000. A sustained recovery above Rs 144,000 would be required to meaningfully improve the short-term structure and could open the way towards Rs 146,000–147,000.
title: Gold price prediction: What's the outlook for gold rates for this week?

description: Lady Gaga and her mother, Cynthia Germanotta, celebrated a remarkable achievement with the Born This Way Foundation as they announced that more than 100,000 individuals have successfully earned the Be There Certificate worldwide. This milestone, part of the Generation Be There campaign, emphasizes the foundation's commitment to promoting mental health awareness and education, enabling compassionate responses to those facing mental health challenges in their communities.
title: Lady Gaga's foundation trained over 100,000 people to support mental health

description: Julie Sweet, CEO of Accenture, bought 12,200 shares on October 26, 2026, increasing her total holdings. This purchase contrasts with the trend of insider selling in the company. Over the past year, only two insider buys occurred compared to 25 sells, indicating mixed insider activity. Accenture is also expanding its artificial intelligence workforce as part of its growth strategy.

description: Hollie Tang, a talented student from Wilson High School, has innovatively developed a system named Tonguage, designed to empower individuals with disabilities. This groundbreaking technology enables users to navigate devices through tongue movements and eye blinks. Winning the top scholarship at the Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair in Phoenix, Tang highlighted the potential of technology to enhance lives.
title: Meet Hollie Tang, who built blink-and-tongue computer control, won $10,000

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Tennessee woman returned from abroad in 2021 to discover that her late brother's house had been sold using a fake identity and forged documents. After she sued the company involved in the sale, a lower court dismissed her case. On Thursday, an appeals court revived her fraud claim but upheld the dismissal of her negligence claim.
title: Tennessee woman finds strangers in inherited home after fake heir sells it

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India will start a five-match ODI series against New Zealand at Eden Park, which has historically been challenging for them. Their ODI record at this venue shows only four wins out of eleven matches played against New Zealand. In their last encounter on November 25, 2022, New Zealand won by seven wickets in chase of 307 runs.
title: India at Auckland's Eden Park: Wins, losses and record ahead of New Zealand ODI series

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The Bureau of Immigration emphasizes that the Air Suvidha Self-Declaration Form is essential for all air passengers. Indian passport holders, OCI cardholders, and foreign nationals must complete this form before arrival. This online form is part of COVID-19 screening measures and includes health status and travel details. Travelers should prepare necessary documents like their passport and visa to fill in the form.
title: Government has an important reminder for everyone coming to India from abroad

author: RICHA PINTO
description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation has faced pressure from the BJP to take down Dia Mirza's video from its Diwali campaign, which promotes a firecracker-free festive season. Though the campaign also features Madhuri Dixit and Nishigandha Wad, Ameet Satam has expressed concerns over Mirza's involvement, suggesting her links to anti-India sentiments. Interestingly, he did not object to the other artists, viewing them as emblematic of culture and sports.
title: Dia Mirza's appeal to avoid Diwali firecrackers draws BJP MLA's ire; BMC deletes video

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Big setback for AAP ahead of Punjab elections; 3 rebel MLAs join BJP

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu has intensified over the Bay of Bengal and will impact Chennai soon. It is projected to make landfall on the south Andhra Pradesh coast around midnight or early Tuesday morning. Wind speeds are expected to reach 100-110 kmph with gusts up to 120 kmph during the storm. Heavy rain has already started in Chennai and surrounding districts, leading to significant rainfall amounts.
title: Cyclone Murasu: Chennai, Vijayawada flights hit; Andhra on alert ahead of landfall

author: SRINATH VUDALI
description: Malkajgiri police recently uncovered a fertility racket involving women from seven states, including West Bengal and Odisha. The accused operated through a network of agents who matched donors with recipients based on various preferences like caste and complexion. Compensation for the donors varied, with some offered as much as ₹50,000 depending on specific requests. Investigators are also looking into the involvement of IVF centres in verifying donor identities.
title: Caste, religion, & education: How Hyderabad IVF racket handpicked egg donors

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'Rs 10,000 crore loss': Delhi traders allege business disruption due to INDIA bloc rally

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Customers withdrew substantial amounts from Binance following a significant security breach that resulted in a major cryptocurrency theft. Despite initial panic, Binance reassured users and resumed withdrawal services for several cryptocurrencies. The exchange replaced nearly all stolen assets, utilizing its own funds for the recovery. Meanwhile, the broader cryptocurrency market showed signs of recovery after the incident. Binance has committed to covering the financial losses from this event.
title: $3.64 bn pulled from world's largest crypto exchange Binance after $6.3 bn heist

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Oil prices dropped over 1% following ongoing talks between Iranian and Qatari officials aimed at reducing conflict. Brent crude futures fell to $111.84, while US West Texas Intermediate crude fell to $102.56. The drop in prices followed a strong increase seen last week before the US midterm elections. Opec+ has kept production targets unchanged due to ongoing disruptions. Market observers remain cautious about potential military escalations after the elections.
title: Oil prices today: Crude falls over 1% as Iran-Qatar talks raise hopes of diplomacy

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Tennis legends Steffi Graf and Andre Agassi have two children, Jaden and Jaz, but neither followed their parents into professional tennis. Jaden pursued baseball, playing for USC and later representing Team Germany in World Baseball Classic Qualifiers. Jaz developed interests in dancing and horseback riding. The couple deliberately avoided putting sporting pressure on their children, choosing instead to let them discover their own passions and identities.
title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s parenting choice kept their children away from tennis spotlight

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli made history on Sunday by becoming the youngest Formula One world champion at the age of 20. Antonelli secured the title after finishing third in a dramatic Mexico City Grand Prix, which was won by Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
title: Kimi Antonelli creates history, becomes youngest F1 world champion

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: India have smashed 400 sixes in 40 T20Is in 2026, becoming the first team to reach the landmark in a calendar year. From Abhishek Sharma's six-hitting at the top to a fearless approach across the batting order, India are redefining T20 batting. Power-hitting coach Julian Wood explains why India are ahead of the curve.
title: 400 and counting: Why India are ahead of the curve in six-hitting

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Venture into the depths of Vietnam's Son Doong Cave, where a hidden world unfolds beneath ancient limestone. Initially stumbled upon by Ho Khanh in 1990, it wasn’t until 2009 that this enchanting cavern was fully mapped, revealing colossal rock formations and a flowing river carved by nature over eons. Since 2013, tours have allowed adventurers to glimpse this delicate ecosystem while promoting sustainable tourism efforts.
title: Vietnam's Son Doong: world's largest cave holds jungle, found by local in 1990

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Gautam Gambhir, the head coach of India, voiced his worries regarding the untested bowling lineup for the imminent ODI series against New Zealand. With seasoned players like Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya missing, the team will depend on bowlers such as Mohammed Siraj and Arshdeep Singh. Gambhir emphasises that if the team's performance shines, the bowlers deserve significant recognition.
title: Gautam Gambhir flags India's biggest challenge ahead of NZ ODIs

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a tough phone call regarding Iran and military strategies. They discussed the possibility of military action after the upcoming US midterm elections. Trump expressed readiness for diplomacy, while Netanyahu urged immediate strikes against Iran. Diplomatic initiatives continue, with the US Vice President sending a letter to Iran's national security chief.
title: Fresh Iran strikes after US midterms? Inside Trump-Netanyahu's 'tough' call

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An extraordinary Lewis chessman carving has fetched an impressive £735,000 at auction. Hidden away in a drawer for more than 55 years by the family of the dealer, this remarkable figure was revealed as a warder, part of the legendary Lewis Chessmen collection. Originally found in 1831, this collection comprises 93 intricately carved pieces from 1150 to 1200 AD, though the auction leaves four original pieces still unaccounted for.
title: £5 Lewis chess piece found in drawer sells for £735,000 after decades

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Prashant Chaudhary established the CodeYogi Foundation to enhance technology education for students in rural India and foster AI literacy. With a positive impact on over 350,000 students across nine states, the foundation’s smartphone-based learning approach has made education both accessible and cost-effective. Recognized with the Rohini Nayyar Prize for his efforts in rural development, Chaudhary's goal is to extend reach to five million students within three years through collaborative partnerships.
title: Meerut village's first IITian wins Rs 10 lakh prize for reaching 3.5 lakh rural students

author: SURENDRA SINGH
title: Israel's IAI on verge of winning $900m deal for six refuelling aircraft for IAF: Reports

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Sanju Samson's performance in the T20I series against New Zealand raised eyebrows, as he could only amass 67 runs over five encounters. His struggles culminated in just four runs during the final match, prompting discussions about alternatives like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Ravichandran Ashwin lightheartedly responded to critiques on social media. After initially leading 3-0, India concluded the series 3-2, following New Zealand's comeback in the last two games.
title: 'Sanju mera first-choice': Ashwin comes to Samson's defence after New Zealand series struggles

author: TNN
title: SC upholds HC order allowing I-T to reassess income of ex-CJI's sons

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'Mayday mayday': Videos show moment Florida jet crashed near busy road

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Actor Chad Lowe and wife Kim Painter have reportedly listed their 3,239-square-foot Mar Vista home for $3.249 million, weeks after the death of their 13-year-old daughter, Fiona. The couple purchased the four-bedroom property for $3.15 million in March 2025. According to TMZ, they have already accepted an offer, subject to certain conditions.
title: Chad Lowe and wife list $3.2m Mar Vista home weeks after daughter's death

author: SANDEEP RAGHAVAN
description: Hemanth, a 21-year-old, attacked two Class X girls at a school in Raptadu on Saturday morning. After the brutal incident, he fled, prompting a significant police manhunt in Anantapur district. On Sunday evening, police located him in the Atmakur forest area, where he resisted arrest and injured an officer. In self-defense, police fired upon Hemanth, critically injuring him before transporting him to a hospital.
title: Andhra chainsaw-wielding ‘stalker’ shot at by cops near forest

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Idaho Supreme Court has revived a legal dispute involving condominium owners challenging changes to property ownership. The contentious amendments were made by the Crystal Beach Condominium Association, affecting owners' shares and rental rules. A previous dismissal by a lower court has been partly overturned, confirming owners' rights to challenge changes impacting their property. Plaintiffs now have their claims for declaratory relief and title slander allowed to proceed.
title: Idaho Supreme Court revives challenge to condo ownership despite 88% vote

author: SANDEEP MOUDGAL
description: Fresh allegations of fraud have emerged related to Sri Guru Raghavendra Sahakara Bank Niyamitha involving mortgaged properties. Properties with ongoing financial disputes had previously been sold to unsuspecting buyers, exposing a troubling issue. The bank lacks accurate data on these properties, complicating efforts to determine ownership and value. An association representing affected homeowners has urged the bank to halt any further actions against their interests.
title: Over Rs 960cr scam? 127 plots sold, then mortgaged to scam-hit bank in Bengaluru

author: RASHMI DROLIA
title: Mahadev betting app promoter extradited from Oman, to face CBI court today

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A legal dispute involving home insurance coverage in Travis County has been returned to court for further hearings. The Texas Third Court of Appeal overturned a previous ruling that held the insurer liable for damages. Homeowners claimed that earth movement caused significant damage to their properties, leading to a denial of their insurance claims. The appeals court requires the insurer to demonstrate the cause of the landslide.
title: Texas homes collapse down 80-foot slope, court reopens insurance fight
